## The maintainer's notes from the offline test (verbatim; each is filed)

The four middle ones arrived as queued input while the session was working (00:59-01:06 UTC); they reached the session and were filed at 01:06-01:07. Nothing the maintainer typed is unaccounted for.

- 21:58 UTC (→ #189): *"It currently is reporting that nothing is going on on the device. Has it finished searching for all the old offline achievements that could be supported?"*
- 23:59 (the test's purpose): *"Yes, that was actually the achievement that I lost while traveling that made me want to figure out how offline achievements could be possible. I was going to try to generate that achievement again as a test, if you think that would be a good way to test the resiliency of the system for fully offline achievements, and if we're ready for that now."*
- 00:07 (→ #190): *"With the latest build, trying to launch Retro Achievements from the main menu just gets stuck on "Please Wait" while I'm offline."* and *"It also isn't timing out."*
- 00:59 (→ #191): *"It says I'm connected to the network, but it's not the SSID that I'm actually connected to that shows up in Wi-Fi SSID. It looks as if I was connected to one of the networks that perhaps it remembered. I didn't know we'd implemented this yet. If we implemented remembering networks, we need to fully finish the work so it shows the correct SSID from memory and also lets you have a new menu to manage networks (so you can remove old networks). Right now, it's showing me the Wi-Fi SSID that I last connected to, not what I'm currently connected to."*
- 01:00 (→ #192): *"Also, doesn't the device know if it's online by the time it starts up and shows EmulationStation? The first step of SaveSync says 'Looking for network,' but shouldn't it already know by that point?"*
- 01:02 (→ #193): *"When offline, I select a ROM and then go to View this game's achievements. It says, 'You're not online, showing what's saved on this device,' and then the percentage and a blue bar, but the percentage and the bar are not aligned (I mean the progress bar). Also, when it says, 'You're not online, showing what's saved on this device,' we're not specifying what we mean by 'showing what's saved on this device.' You could simply say, 'Saved. You're not online.' Say, 'You are offline,' and instead of saying 'showing what's saved on this device,' say 'showing your most recent progress' (actually, probably makes more sense)."*
- 01:06 (→ #194): *"When I'm offline and I start the game from a game save, it said 'RetroAchievements logged in.' If we can control this, we might want to say 'RetroAchievements connected or logged in' and then 'offline' in parentheses after 'logged in' to make it clear. Also, the problem was the transparent background behind it didn't extend to cover the full length of the background behind the text."*
- 01:21 (→ #195; "Please try again" = reach the RG SP again, which the watcher does): *"Please try again. Also, the timestamp when I duplicated the save was in the wrong time zone, and so it was ahead. I don't think it calculated the UTC offset for the current time where I am. Also, the auto save doesn't seem like it's at the right time. To be honest, it looks like the saves aren't syncing or working correctly with the clock because it's saying I saved at 9:07 pm, but it's 9:19 pm, and 12 minutes have not passed."*
- 01:25: *"Let's stash our work, including my recent unsent messages around the timestamp and other items, and make sure this is all captured in our stash."* -- this file.

## Notes for Next Session

- **Standing rules that bind:** nothing runs on a person's device without a per-action yes by device name after an idle check (staging asked too, D-QA-011; the reboot is always its own question; `tools/device-act`); QA guests a/b/d/e may be rebooted freely; guest/device reads mask values (`sed -E 's/((passw[a-z]*|token|key)[=:][ ]*)[^ ",]+/\1<masked>/gI'` plus the `y=|t=|p=` query fields) and replace the QA account's name with `<account>`; **the account's name must not enter the repo** (crop frames whose title or USERNAME row shows it; two RC-6 commits on `next` briefly carried one -- the maintainer was told); credentials only via `tools/qa-accounts <port> ra|screenscraper|clear`, never printed, never asked for; commits `git -c user.name="Max Engel" -c user.email="max@awecelot.com"` ending with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>` and `Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01LkFLXE5GsT1apn8AwrxrGR`; register append-only; audit/review subagents `model: "fable"`.
- **One builder per build worktree:** `pgrep -f 'make docker-[A-Z]'` before `tools/fork-worktree sync`; x64 via `/workspace/tmp/rocknix-session/build-x64.sh` (edit its ID line; `rm -f .stamps/image/build_target` first); H700 via `/workspace/repos/rocknix.worktrees/devices/build-dev.sh H700`; both ~3-4 min warm. `current-x64-id` = `f55cc952f3`, `current-x64-img` = the RC-10 image path.
- **A game in the foreground swallows a whole proof run and every check still "reads".** The 00:52 run is the case: frames were "captured" under their step names, timers measured the game's animation, greps of the interface's log returned zeros. Before any walk, `pgrep -f '^/usr/bin/retroarch'` on the guest; after the press that opens the main menu, a frame that proves it opened. A named frame proves nothing about what is in it -- look at one.
- **Harness lessons (also in `generic-x64-vm-testing.md`):** the interface runs under `essway.service` through `start_es.sh` → `/etc/profile`, so a PATH shim goes in `/storage/.config/profile.d/` (the drop-in's `env PATH=` is reset -- check1's shim FAIL); busybox `pgrep` has no `-c`; `settle` has a dead band; never send a press into a blocked interface thread; a "second change" timer measures nothing when the answer is in the first screenshot; QEMU `set_link off` keeps eth0's address (use `nmcli dev disconnect` to mean Wi-Fi off); `/var/log` persists across boots on the device (exec.log was Sunday's).
- **The VM cannot reproduce the RG SP's PLEASE WAIT:** name resolution on its dead link fails at once and the proxy answers in 40 ms; the device's per-request cost (~1 s offline) is the chain. RC-10's proof of the fix is by construction (one ctl call, no probe) plus the timing at 100 games -- which still has to be taken (Next Steps 2).
- **ES flush lag (#178):** WARNING/INFO lines reach `/var/log/es_log.txt` 8 batches late; ERRORs go to the journal at once; the RG SP's INFO lines also reach its journal via `start_es.sh`.
- **Queued input:** notes the maintainer types while the session works arrive as queued commands (in the transcript as `queue-operation` / `queued_command` entries, not user turns). Treat each as a message: file it (D-QA-012) and answer it.
- The session scripts and logs live in `/workspace/tmp/rocknix-session/` (not the scratchpad, which can vanish).
- Fable subagents delivered ES branches twice (`feature/ra-running`, the RC-5 notes); briefs must say "wait synchronously, never start a background task and return"; `model: "fable"`.
